name: Buy X range, get Y
description: Customer must buy every product in the X range to get Y free
title: Buy X range, get Y

x.heading: Customer buys
x.help: The customer must have every one of these products or variants in their cart. Selecting all of a product's variants means any variant of that product counts.

y.heading: Customer gets
y.help: These are added to the cart automatically and made free once every item above is in the cart. For products with several variants, tick the variants to give; each ticked variant is added.

maxUses.heading: Maximum discount uses per order
maxUses.label: Set a maximum number of uses per order

errors.maxUses: Uses per order must be a whole number of 1 or more.
errors.required: Select at least one product the customer buys and one variant the customer gets.
errors.overlap: A product can't be in both "Customer buys" and "Customer gets".
errors.storefront: The discount was saved, but the storefront auto-add settings couldn't be updated. Save again to retry.
